notes: Price rules from the wiki's Trade and Traders pages: a trader pays 60% of market value and charges 140% (an educated reading of the page, which also says the difficulty's trade price disadvantage adds to buy and cuts sell prices; see Difficulties). The Social skill improves both sides through the TradePriceImprovement stat; the wiki gives no formula, so the straight line 0 at Social 0 to 40% at Social 20 is ours for now. Orbital traders: one chance every 15 days, staying 40,000 RimWorld ticks (16 game hours). Caravans: five possible dates per 60-day year, at least six days apart, about three to five accepted. A trader with less silver than a deal costs takes the surplus goods free (C23). silver is the money: Silver, market value 1.
